summary: code picks the reviewer, deep on Opus for risky diffs
appCreator: Reviews now run on Sonnet by default and on Opus (a new reviewer-deep agent) only when code finds a risky change: the platform layer, AI modules, sign-in, migrations, or a diff over 400 lines. build-feature asks 'review-precheck.mjs risk' which one to run, so no thread judges risk itself. Packs list their own risky paths.
notVerified: That a Project thread really runs reviewer-deep on Opus when build-feature names it (agent pins were proven in #250, but this exact flow is only checked by the branch scenario). Path patterns can miss a risky change in an unexpected file; only size and listed paths count.
